title: Component annotation labelled with a type not a subtype
description:
One component annotation carries the expected label `third_party`, which is a component *type*, not a subtype. Every other component gold label is a valid `component-taxonomy.yaml` subtype id.

Single instance, and a live counterexample to the rule the taxonomy story asserts — an annotator picked a value outside the defined subtype list.

Startable now — independent of the gate rulings.
